### not great: only ACK if next (2) 


* <i>works</i> because we still have timeouts 
<hr class="vspace" />
* but we'd like to give more feedback to receiver


### againframe(twoAndTimeouts)

### better idea: always ACK  {.smaller}



::: {.r-stack}
![](/reliable-window/texfig/two-at-a-time-dupack-better-idea-always-ack.figure-1.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=1 width=1000px}

![](/reliable-window/texfig/two-at-a-time-dupack-better-idea-always-ack.figure-2.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=2 width=1000px}


:::
 

* only ACK $x$ if <em>everything up to and including $x$</em> received
* intuition: ACK tells sender <em>where to start sending more</em>
